test_cases.description: Verifies that `_build_coder_prompt()` calls `build_afspec_from_triage()` and `render_inmemory_spec_sections()`, joins issue body context first then rendered sections, and passes the combined string to `build_system_prompt()`.
preconditions: `fix_pipeline.py` is importable with all dependencies available
`build_afspec_from_triage` is mocked to return a fake `afspec Spec` object
`render_inmemory_spec_sections` is mocked to return a string containing `## Requirements`, `## Test Specification`, and `## Tasks` sections
`build_system_prompt` is mocked to capture its `context` argument
A valid `TriageResult` with acceptance criteria is constructed

input.issue_body: Issue body text describing the bug
input.triage: a TriageResult with two acceptance criteria

expected.context_arg_to_build_system_prompt: starts with issue body text, followed by ## Requirements, ## Test Specification, and ## Tasks sections

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
mock build_afspec_from_triage returning fake_afspec
mock render_inmemory_spec_sections returning '## Requirements\n...\n## Test Specification\n...\n## Tasks\n...'
mock build_system_prompt capturing context kwarg

system_prompt, task_prompt = _build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)

assert build_afspec_from_triage called once with (spec, triage)
assert render_inmemory_spec_sections called once with fake_afspec
captured_context = build_system_prompt.call_args.kwargs['context']
assert captured_context.startswith('Issue body text')
assert '## Requirements' in captured_context
assert '## Test Specification' in captured_context
assert '## Tasks' in captured_context
assert captured_context.index('Issue body text') < captured_context.index('## Requirements')

test_cases.description: Verifies that `FixReviewResult` and `parse_fix_review_output` are unmodified and correctly parse a JSON verdict report containing `criterion_id`, `verdict`, and `evidence` fields.
preconditions: `parse_fix_review_output` is importable from `agentfox.nightshift.fix_pipeline`
`FixReviewResult` dataclass is importable
A sample JSON verdict string with afspec-style criterion IDs (e.g. 'NS-REQ-1') is prepared

input.verdict_json: {"verdicts": [{"criterion_id": "NS-REQ-1", "verdict": "pass", "evidence": "The fix correctly handles the null case."}]}

expected.first_verdict_evidence: The fix correctly handles the null case.

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
verdict_json = '{"verdicts": [{"criterion_id": "NS-REQ-1", "verdict": "pass", "evidence": "The fix correctly handles the null case."}]}'

result = parse_fix_review_output(verdict_json)

assert isinstance(result, FixReviewResult)
assert result.verdicts[0].criterion_id == 'NS-REQ-1'
assert result.verdicts[0].verdict == 'pass'
assert result.verdicts[0].evidence == 'The fix correctly handles the null case.'

property_tests.description: For any successful invocation of `_build_coder_prompt()` or `_build_reviewer_prompt()` where `build_afspec_from_triage()` succeeds, `_render_criteria_context()` must never be called.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: arbitrary valid TriageResult objects (varying number of acceptance criteria from 1 to 20, varying field content)
property_tests.invariant_check:
mock build_afspec_from_triage to succeed (return a fake Spec)
mock _render_criteria_context to record calls
for each generated triage in sample:
    _render_criteria_context_calls = 0
    _build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)
    assert _render_criteria_context_calls == 0
    _render_criteria_context_calls = 0
    _build_reviewer_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)
    assert _render_criteria_context_calls == 0

property_tests.description: For any invocation of `_build_coder_prompt()` or `_build_reviewer_prompt()` that produces a combined context string, the issue body always appears before the afspec-rendered (or fallback) sections.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: arbitrary issue_body strings (non-empty) and arbitrary TriageResult objects; also includes cases where build_afspec_from_triage raises (fallback path)
property_tests.invariant_check:
for each (issue_body, triage) in sample:
    captured_context = capture context arg to build_system_prompt from _build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)
    assert captured_context.index(issue_body) < first_section_header_index(captured_context)
    captured_context = capture context arg to build_system_prompt from _build_reviewer_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)
    assert captured_context.index(issue_body) < first_section_header_index(captured_context)

where first_section_header_index finds the position of the first '##' heading in captured_context

property_tests.description: For any invocation of `_build_coder_prompt()` with non-empty `review_feedback` or `prior_context`, both values appear in the task prompt in the correct positions regardless of whether the afspec or fallback path was taken.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: arbitrary TriageResult objects (both valid and malformed to trigger both paths), arbitrary non-empty review_feedback strings, arbitrary non-empty prior_context strings
property_tests.invariant_check:
for each (triage, review_feedback, prior_context) in sample:
    _, task_prompt = _build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body, review_feedback=review_feedback, prior_context=prior_context)
    assert prior_context in task_prompt
    assert review_feedback in task_prompt
    assert task_prompt.index(prior_context) < task_prompt.index(review_feedback)

property_tests.description: For any execution that calls `_format_triage_comment()`, it always calls `_render_criteria_section()` with `bold=True` and never calls `render_inmemory_spec_sections()`.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: arbitrary TriageResult objects (varying acceptance criteria counts and content)
property_tests.invariant_check:
mock _render_criteria_section to record calls and arguments
mock render_inmemory_spec_sections to record calls
for each triage in sample:
    _render_criteria_section_calls = []
    render_inmemory_spec_sections_calls = []
    _format_triage_comment(triage)
    assert any(call.kwargs.get('bold') == True for call in _render_criteria_section_calls)
    assert len(render_inmemory_spec_sections_calls) == 0

property_tests.description: For any execution of `parse_fix_review_output` after this change, it correctly parses JSON verdict reports with any `criterion_id` values (including new afspec-style IDs) into `FixReviewResult` without schema validation failure.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: arbitrary criterion_id strings (including 'NS-REQ-1', 'AC-1', 'REQ-42', random alphanumeric strings), arbitrary verdict strings ('pass', 'fail', 'skip'), arbitrary evidence strings
property_tests.invariant_check:
for each (criterion_id, verdict, evidence) in sample:
    json_str = format_verdict_json(criterion_id, verdict, evidence)
    result = parse_fix_review_output(json_str)
    assert isinstance(result, FixReviewResult)
    assert result.verdicts[0].criterion_id == criterion_id
    assert result.verdicts[0].verdict == verdict
    assert result.verdicts[0].evidence == evidence

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test for the happy path: coder prompt is built with afspec-rendered context when `build_afspec_from_triage()` succeeds.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call `_build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)` with a valid `TriageResult` containing acceptance criteria, with `build_afspec_from_triage` and `render_inmemory_spec_sections` using real implementations from spec 01.
mockable: build_system_prompt() (capture context arg without full LLM integration)
expected_effects: build_afspec_from_triage() is called with the spec and triage arguments
render_inmemory_spec_sections() is called with the returned afspec Spec object
The context passed to build_system_prompt() begins with the issue body and contains ## Requirements, ## Test Specification, and ## Tasks sections
The returned task_prompt contains 'Refer to the tasks subtask list in the context above'
No exception is raised
_render_criteria_context() is NOT called

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test for the fallback path: when `build_afspec_from_triage()` raises, `_build_coder_prompt()` falls back to ad-hoc criteria rendering and does not propagate the exception.
smoke_tests.trigger: Call `_build_coder_prompt(spec, triage, issue_body)` with `build_afspec_from_triage` mocked to raise a `ValueError`.
expected_effects: No exception propagated to the caller
A WARNING-level log entry is emitted describing the afspec construction failure
_render_criteria_context() is called once
The context passed to build_system_prompt() contains the ad-hoc criteria text
A valid (system_prompt, task_prompt) tuple is returned
